intervals: start_frame inclusive, end_frame exclusive; seconds = frame / 30

segments.coverage: Every picture cut, no gap/overlap, covers 0..total_frames. Intro/card/outro have no narration cues. CTA is R034 body with existing 3-second hold.

scenes.order: exact script.scenes array, never lexical sort

cues.quantization: first visible frame = ceil(local_start_s*30); exclusive end = ceil(local_end_s*30); native seconds retained

beats.quantization: ceil(native local seconds * 30), then scene start_frame

progressions: [{kind,scene_id,beat_frames,timing_basis}] uses same QA normal form; representative scenes R003=funding_waterfall, R006=ltv_dsr, R030=monthly_budget
source_manifest: {script_sha256,files:[{path,sha256}]} includes scene projects/fonts/images/JS/CSS, rendered MP4s, original voice WAV, native timing, assembly code and chapter assets
gap_policy: Do not add narrator proposed 0.25s: source WAV already includes natural tail. Keep all PCM samples; pad only to CFR or justified scene read hold. Chapters are independent 90-frame clips. No silent duplicate gap clips.
outro_policy: outro_start_frame=max(ceil((last_speech_global_s+3)*30), last_scene_start_frame+ceil(actual_PCM_seconds*30)); final WAV already contains 3s hold, never add twice
